passages.text: Chief complaint: headache worsening over three weeks.
History: new double vision for one week.
Neurologic exam: cranial nerves II through XII assessed; left sixth cranial nerve palsy. Strength, sensation, and gait normal.
Impression: progressive headache with new cranial nerve palsy raises concern for an intracranial mass.
Plan: order MRI brain without and with contrast (CPT 70553).
